description: This class is designed to be used in conjunction with the ConfigurationSerializable API. Object streams on their own are not safe. For safer and more consistent serialization of items, use ItemStack.serializeAsBytes() or ItemStack.serializeItemsAsBytes(java.util.Collection) . This class is designed to be used in conjunction with the ConfigurationSerializable API. It translates objects to an internal implementation for later deserialization using BukkitObjectInputStream .
